description: Defines the KmlParser class for parsing KML files to extract GPS fixes, with static methods for parsing files and strings.

classes.name: KmlParser
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to parse KML files and strings to extract GPS fixes.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses a .kml file specified by filePath and extracts GPS fixes into the provided fixes array; returns success status.

methods.name: parseString
methods.description: Parses a given string containing KML data to extract GPS fixes, returning success status.
